review.notes: Structure: the single ```txt fence in Appendix A.1 is balanced and reproduces the printed evaluation prompt including its trailing '# Question/# Reference Answer/# Answer To Be Judged' lines. Word-level diff of extracted text from all 14 physical pages against the OCR markdown; remaining diff lines are LaTeX subscript tokenization, two-column hyphenation artifacts (chat-bot, Bal-can, Syn-naeve) and figure-internal labels. Tables 1-6 present with matching values; Table 2's '# Tokens (Speech/Text) | Epochs' header structure matches the print (visually verified on p.6). Pages 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9 and 13 rendered and inspected, key crops at 300 dpi. The print's own typos 'supverised', 'dateset' and the camel-case 'Speechtokenizer' reference title are restored, not corrected.
